_comment: Experiment 2 of the weekday-geometry series: weekday probe-score injection with a TRAINABLE direction. Passed to scripts/injection_train.py via --activation-config. The 'class'/'kwargs' fields in the source spec are honored by the _open_injection_source hook (applied on this branch); they wire the WeekdayProbeScoreSource subclass and its realism threshold (present_z=2.0). 'class' uses the collision-proof FILE-PATH form (path/to/file.py:Class, resolved from the launch CWD = repo root) — ALL weekday configs standardize on it (the dotted-module form is env-fragile: an installed PyPI 'runs' package shadows the local runs/ namespace dir). Gate abs:0.0273 is an absolute scalar (raw residual-RMS fraction), so NO loudness.json / startup calibration is involved.
